Description: QML Quick Controls 2 ships styles: Basic/Fusion/Material/Universal/macOS/iOS
Do: Set the style once at startup before loading QML
Don't: Mix per-control native overrides ad hoc

Guideline: Customize via the style not inline
Do: Set Material.theme / Material.accent at Application root

Description: Centralize colors/sizes in one QML singleton
Do: Create a Theme.qml singleton (pragma Singleton) and reference Theme.accent
Code Good: pragma Singleton; readonly property color accent: "#2563eb"

Don't: Anchor children inside a Layout item

Description: Bindings re-run on every dependency change
Do: Keep bindings cheap; compute in C++/Python and expose properties
Don't: Do loops/filtering inside a property binding

Description: Large lists must virtualize and reuse delegates
Screen readers need names/roles on custom items
Do: Add Accessible.name/role to custom controls and icon buttons
Expose a QObject with Signals/Slots/Properties via setContextProperty or QML_ELEMENT
Don't: Call Python by string-building or globals

Description: QML animations are easy to overuse
Don't: Animate x/y/width every frame with long durations

Description: QML uses logical pixels; scaling is automatic
Do: Use implicit sizes + Layout hints; SVG icons
